method: Decompose the complete previously certified0.0001mm inset raw ORIGINAL cog/cog collision core, retaining every source-angle tooth and concavity. All convex pieces must lie strictly inside the actual raw original collision polygon, and their whole union must equal the core. Use necessary outside rounding: round normalized edge coefficients, bound their exact rational error over the full signed coordinate range, then FLOOR the edge bound MINUS that error. Any original nonoverlapping pair necessarily satisfies at least one weakened outside inequality per piece. This is an original-outline necessary relaxation; it omits positive moving-pair clearance only in the master, never in full-original/native validation or H5. No solver call and no claim that a positive is valid.
